source_title: What to Watch this week: ‘The One About Matthew Perry,’ Inde Navarrette hosts ‘SNL’ - Entertainment Weekly
source_excerpt:
Gareth Cattermole/Getty Images for IMDb; Netflix; Zach Dilgard/Paramount+ with SHOWTIME
Featuring unreleased photos and video from his family’s private archive, the docuseries The One About Matthew Perry goes in-depth on the late Friends star’s life, told by some of those who knew him best, including his sister Mia Perry Bowick and lifelong best friends.
Also on TV, Michael C. Hall is back for a new season of Dexter: Resurrection , which promises more blood and kills for its 20th anniversary. Plus, Obsession star Inde Navarrette hosts Saturday Night Live , American Horror Story 13 wraps up, and a new season of The Gilded Age premieres.
In theaters, Wicker starring Alexander Skarsgård expands nationwide, and the war movie The Mosquito Bowl — directed by Peter Berg and starring Nicholas Galitzine, Tom Francis, Bill Skarsgård, and Ray Nicholson — opens.
Get your daily dose of entertainment news, celebrity updates, and what to watch with our EW Dispatch newsletter .
